messages:
sarah-support: FYI AcmeCorp escalated — long streaming SSE responses sometimes end abruptly with an unterminated JSON object and no finish_reason. customer says last chunk never arrives, parser throws EOF. attaching the client's dump and our proxy logs.

alex-eng-runtime: thanks. do we have correlation with auth rotation or proxy timeouts? any error ids?

sarah-support: customer ticket ACME-7843. They recorded a client-side stream capture (Android):
```
GET /v1/streams?model=opt-13b HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <rotating-token>
Accept: text/event-stream
Connection: keep-alive

--stream data--
data: {"id":"tok_1","delta":"...","finish_reason":null}

data: {"id":"tok_1","delta":"..."}

/* stream stops here, no closing brace, no final event */
```
Customer noticed a token refresh at ~2023-11-10T12:04:25Z and the stream cut at 12:04:26Z.

tim-devex: repro attempt on my side to mimic long responses: I ran a generator that delays final tokens by ~90s. curl to SSE endpoint looked normal until ~62s, then connection closed from client side when our auth refresh happened. repro steps:
```
# reproduce
TOKEN=shortlived
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -N \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?delay_final=90\"
# rotate token in parallel to simulate mobile SDK refresh
```

maria-eng-sre: checked edge logs (fastly) around the timestamps. fastly shows connection reset to client with 200 OK proxied but no final chunk forwarded. snippet from edge: 
```
edge: conn_closed_by_backend id=... reason=upstream_idle_timeout
upstream: 200 OK streamed bytes=... last_chunk_time=2023-11-10T12:04:26Z
```
Looks like an upstream idle flush or backend connection closed while still streaming.

alex-eng-runtime: possible triggers: (1) auth token rotation triggers client to re-open and the proxy drops the existing stream, (2) our runtime doesn't flush final KV/cache chunk if session closed mid-commit, (3) intermediary (CDN/proxy) has an inactivity threshold and trims trailing bytes.

sarah-support: customer said they saw billing/ retry spikes because their client retried after the incomplete parse. they're asking for a patch or a docs workaround.

maria-eng-sre: short-term mitigations:
- Ask customer to disable mid-stream token rotation (use longer-lived token or refresh via separate control channel).
- Enable periodic heartbeats from runtime: send `:`
` or `event: heartbeat
data: {}`

` every 20s to keep proxies from considering connection idle.
- Configure CDN keepalive/timeouts (we can request fastly to bump idle_timeout for this service).

alex-eng-runtime: longer-term: runtime TODOs:
- Ensure a sentinel final SSE event is emitted atomically and flushed (e.g., `event: done
data: {"finish_reason":"stop"}

`) so clients can parse even if trailing JSON is partially buffered by network.
- On graceful shutdown path, force a socket flush and close only after final chunk ack.
- Detect mid-stream Authorization header rotation and log explicit event id so we can correlate.

tim-devex: I can add a small SDK change for mobile: buffer until `event: done` seen, and guard against partial-JSON parse by appending a short trailing sentinel on reconnect attempts. Will draft PR.

sarah-support: escalation created: INC-2026-117 (P1->P2), assigned to eng-runtime and eng-sre. customer notified.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026.11.10.03 -> eng-runtime/runtime-service succeeded at 2026-11-10T13:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

maria-eng-sre: action items:
- (me) open a fastly ticket to request temporary idle_timeout bump for this route.
- (alex) add sentinel end-event and flush logic in runtime (small patch).
- (tim) SDK guard for partial parse + doc snippet about token rotation.
- (sarah) provide customer workaround steps and advise to pause mid-stream token rotations for now.

alex-eng-runtime: quick note on root cause hypothesis: mobile SDK rotating auth mid-stream -> client re-auth flow causes connection teardown on client/edge, backend finishes writing but last bytes get lost in CDN buffer. finish_reason absent because final JSON didn't fully reach client.

sarah-support: thanks all. I'll send customer the workaround and update the ticket with repro steps and our mitigation timeline. cc @maria-eng-sre for fastly ticket link. :pray:

maria-eng-sre: fastly ticket opened FTLY-1129, asking for 120s idle timeout for streaming path while we ship fix. will update when they respond.

alex-eng-runtime: patch branch ready: runtime/sse-end-sentinel. Adds `event: done
data: {"finish_reason":"stop"}

` and ensures flush before close. will post PR link shortly.

sarah-support: great — keeping customer updated. will close once sentinel is live and customer confirms parser no longer fails.
